{"status":"OK","messages":[{"level":"info","content":"Creating logstats.mjs.<|"|>}],"files":[{"path":"logstats.mjs","content":"import fs from 'node:fs';
import readline from 'node:readline';
import path from 'node:path';

async function processLogFile(filePath, filterLevel) {
  const fileStream = fs.createReadStream(filePath);
  const rl = readline.createInterface({
    input: fileStream,
    crlfDelay: Infinity,
  });

  let totalLines = 0;
  let skippedLines = 0;
  const levelCounts = {};
  const messageCounts = {};
  let firstTimestamp = null;
  let lastTimestamp = null;

  for await (const line of rl) {
    totalLines++;
    if (!line.trim()) {
      skippedLines++;
      continue;
    }

    let logEntry;
    try {
      logEntry = JSON.parse(line);
    } catch (err) {
      skippedLines++;
      continue;
    }

    const { level, message, timestamp } = logEntry;

    if (!level || !message || !timestamp) {
      skippedLines++;
      continue;
    }

    // Apply level filter if provided
    if (filterLevel && level !== filterLevel) {
      continue;
    }

    // Update counts
    levelCounts[level] = (levelCounts[level] || 0) + 1;
    messageCounts[message] = (messageCounts[message] || 0) + 1;

    // Update timestamps
    const currentTimestamp = new Date(timestamp);
    if (isNaN(currentTimestamp.getTime())) {
      skippedLines++;
      continue;
    }

    if (!firstTimestamp || currentTimestamp < firstTimestamp) {
      firstTimestamp = currentTimestamp;
    }
    if (!lastTimestamp || currentTimestamp > lastTimestamp) {
      lastTimestamp = currentTimestamp;
    }
  }

  // Print results
  console.log(`Total lines: ${totalLines}`);
  console.log(`Skipped lines: ${skippedLines}`);
  console.log('Counts per level:');
  for (const [level, count] of Object.entries(levelCounts)) {
    console.log(`  ${level}: ${count}`);
  }

  console.log('5 most frequent messages:');
  const sortedMessages = Object.entries(messageCounts)
    .sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1])
    .slice(0, 5);
  for (const [message, count] of sortedMessages) {
    console.log(`  ${message}: ${count}`);
  }

  if (firstTimestamp && lastTimestamp) {
    console.log(`Time range: ${firstTimestamp.toISOString()} - ${lastTimestamp.toISOString()}`);
  } else {
    console.log('Time range: N/A');
  }
}

async function main() {
  const args = process.argv.slice(2);
  if (args.length === 0) {
    console.error('Usage: node logstats.mjs <file> [--level error|warn|info]');
    process.exit(1);
  }

  const filePath = args[0];
  let filterLevel = null;

  if (args.length > 1) {
    const levelIdx = args.indexOf('--level');
    if (levelIdx !== -1 && args[levelIdx + 1]) {
      filterLevel = args[levelIdx + 1];
    } else if (args.length === 2) {
        // If --level is not present but there's a second arg, it might be the level if user didn't use --level flag?
        // But usage says [--level error|warn|info]
    }
  }

  try {
    await processLogFile(path.resolve(filePath), filterLevel);
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(`Error: ${err.message}`);
    process.exit(1);
  }
}

if (import.meta.url === `file://${process.argv[1]}`) {
  main();
}

export { processLogFile };

{"status":"OK","messages":[{"level":"info","content":"Refactoring logstats.mjs to support testing via output stream.<|"|>}],"files":[{"path":"logstats.mjs","content:<|"|>import fs from 'node:fs';
import readline from 'node:readline';
import path from 'node:path';

export async function processLogFile(filePath, filterLevel, outputStream = process.stdout) {
  const fileStream = fs.createReadStream(filePath);
  const rl = readline.createInterface({
    input: fileStream,
    crlfDelay: Infinity,
  });

  let totalLines = 0;
  let skippedLines = 0;
  const levelCounts = {};
  const messageCounts = {};
  let firstTimestamp = null;
  let lastTimestamp = null;

  for await (const line of rl) {
    totalLines++;
    if (!line.trim()) {
      skippedLines++;
      continue;
    }

    let logEntry;
    try {
      logEntry = JSON.parse(line);
    } catch (err) {
      skippedLines++;
      continue;
    }

    const { level, message, timestamp } = logEntry;

    if (level === undefined || message === undefined || timestamp === undefined) {
      skippedLines++;
      continue;
    }

    // Apply level filter if provided
    if (filterLevel && level !== filterLevel) {
      continue;
    }

    // Update counts
    levelCounts[level] = (levelCounts[level] || 0) + 1;
    messageCounts[message] = (messageCounts[message] || 0) + 1;

    // Update timestamps
    const currentTimestamp = new Date(timestamp);
    if (isNaN(currentTimestamp.getTime())) {
      skippedLines++;
      continue;
    }

    if (!firstTimestamp || currentTimestamp < firstTimestamp) {
      firstTimestamp = currentTimestamp;
    }
    if (!lastTimestamp || currentTimestamp > lastTimestamp) {
      lastTimestamp = currentTimestamp;
    }
  }

  // Print results
  outputStream.write(`Total lines: ${totalLines}\n`);
  outputStream.write(`Skipped lines: ${skippedLines}\n`);
  outputStream.write('Counts per level:\n');
  const sortedLevels = Object.keys(levelCounts).sort();
  for (const level of sortedLevels) {
    outputStream.write(`  ${level}: ${levelCounts[level]}\n`);
  }

  outputStream.write('5 most frequent messages:\n');
  const sortedMessages = Object.entries(messageCounts)
    .sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1] || a[0].localeCompare(b[0]))
    .slice(0, 5);
  for (const [message, count] of sortedMessages) {
    outputStream.write(`  ${message}: ${count}\n`);
  }

  if (firstTimestamp && lastTimestamp) {
    outputStream.write(`Time range: ${firstTimestamp.toISOString()} - ${lastTimestamp.toISOString()}\n`);
  } else {
    outputStream.write('Time range: N/A\n');
  }
}

async function main() {
  const args = process.argv.slice(2);
  if (args.length === 0) {
    console.error('Usage: node logstats.mjs <file> [--level error|warn|info]');
    process.exit(1);
  }

  const filePath = args[0];
  let filterLevel = null;

  // Simple argument parsing for --level
  for (let i = 1; i < args.length; i++) {
    if (args[i] === '--level' && args[i + 1]) {
      filterLevel = args[i + 1];
      break;
    }
  }

  try {
    await processLogFile(path.resolve(filePath), filterLevel);
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(`Error: ${err.message}`);
    process.exit(1);
  }
}

// Check if the script is being run directly (not imported)
if (process.argv[1] === undefined || process.argv[1].endsWith('logstats.mjs')) {
  main();
}

{"status":"OK","messages":[{"level":"info","content":"Creating test/logstats.test.mjs.<|"|>}],"files":[{"path":"test/logstats.test.mjs","content:<|"|>import { test, describe } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { Readable } from 'node:stream';
import { processLogFile } from '../logstats.mjs';

const getOutput = async (processLogFileFunc, filePath, filterLevel) => {
  let output = '';
  const mockOutputStream = {
    write: (data) => {
      output += data;
    }
  };
  await processLogFileFunc(filePath, filterLevel, mockOutputStream);
  return output;
};

describe('logstats.mjs', () => {
  const testFilePath = path.resolve('test/logs.json');

  test('level counting', async () => {
    const output = await getOutput(processLogFile, testFilePath, null);
    assert.match(output, /Total lines: 6/);
    assert.match(output, /error: 1/);
    assert.match(output, /warn: 1/);
    assert.match(output, /info: 3/);
  });

  test('malformed-line skipping', async () => {
    const output = await getOutput(processLogFile, testFilePath, null);
    // 6 lines total: 4 valid, 1 invalid JSON, 1 missing timestamp/invalid date
    // Wait, the 'not-a-date' line is valid JSON but invalid timestamp.
    // The '{invalid: "json"}' line is invalid JSON.
    // Let's check how many are skipped.
    // Line 1: valid
    // Line 2: valid
    // Line 3: valid
    // Line 4: valid
    // Line 5: invalid JSON -> skipped
    // Line 6: valid JSON but invalid timestamp -> skipped (as per implementation)
    assert.match(output, /Skipped lines: 2/);
  });

  test('--level filter', async () => {
    const output = await getOutput(processLogFile, testFilePath, 'error');
    assert.match(output, /Total lines: 6/);
    assert.match(output, /error: 1/);
    assert.notMatch(output, /warn: 1/);
    assert.notMatch(output, /info: 3/);
  });
});
